name: Sekiya Naoki
source:
"If you feel that way... I'm happy."

A former idol from the same school as Ichiya. After he injured his eye, he retired and now works as a lecturer at the academy.

Instead of a busy night, he decided to take care of the first generation of the Ichiya Produce Team.

Hobby: Astronomy
Favorite Food: Sakura mochi
Dislikes: Anchovies

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040207195018/http://www.will-game.com/BCM/gb01/char05.htm]official website[/url]]
